chunks: Tell them: "Keep on expecting, I am expecting with you."
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'I am expecting with you' mean in Surah Al-Muthaffifin?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Muthaffifin, this verse serves as a divine reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) during the period of waiting for the final reckoning, emphasizing that while disbelievers await punishment, believers await divine justice. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a model of patient endurance (sabr) for the faithful amidst the trials of their enemies. The verse underscores the certainty of God's decree, distinguishing the ultimate fate of the defrauding disbelievers from the rewarded believers.
